sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

As you progress, the levels become increasingly difficult, with new obstacles and power-ups being introduced. There are several key mechanics to master in Ocean Match Puzzle:

As you progress through the levels, you'll also encounter special sea creatures that have unique abilities.
